title: First EMS Corps Training Class Graduates in San Diego County
description:
San Diego County Fire just graduated its first EMS Corps class, a new program helping young adults launch careers as Emergency Medical Technicians. Over 20 weeks, participants completed 400+ hours of EMS training, hands‑on drills, mentorship, and earned up to 12 college credits through Southwestern College. They also received a monthly stipend and support services to help remove barriers to EMS careers. 

The EMS Corps is part of a statewide effort to expand and diversify California’s emergency medical workforce. A new North County cohort launches this April.

Learn more at sandiegoemscorps.org.
